chapters.label: Live: the 2008 final
chapters.text: Moscow, 2008, the European final. Sinara and El Pozo draw four all, so it goes to penalties. Zuev dives. Saved! He stops three penalties, and Sinara are champions of Europe!

chapters.label: How he did it
chapters.text: Now, how he did it. Pressed, a team-mate passes back. Zuev stops it with his sole, looks up and passes wide, like an outfield player.

chapters.label: Replay: eyes up
chapters.text: Again, slowly. One touch to stop it. Eyes up: the free player. A calm, low pass. Ball kept!

chapters.label: Practise it
chapters.text: Try it with a friend. Use your feet to pass calmly, so your team keeps the ball!
